chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Kufi, from Ali ibn al- Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from- Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from- al-Hakam ibn Miskin, from- Hamza ibn al-Tayyar, who said:

I was in the presence of Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (peace be upon him). He saw me groaning (with pain), so he said: 'What is the matter with you?' I said: 'My tooth (ache).' He said: 'If only you had cupping done.' So I had cupping done and it settled down. I informed him of it, so he said to me: 'There is no better cure for the people than the sucking out of blood or a lick of honey.' I said: 'May I be sacrificed for you, what is a lick of honey?' He said: 'A lick of honey.'
ai.seo_question: What medical advice did Imam al-Rida give for a toothache according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Hamza ibn al-Tayyar narrates his experience with Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him), who prescribed cupping (*hijama*) for his toothache, noting that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his progeny) recommended it as a primary remedy. The Imam further clarified that the optimal therapeutic combination is the removal of blood through cupping paired with the consumption of a small amount of honey (*laz'at 'asal*), highlighting the Sunnah's emphasis on practical, accessible medical treatments.

en.hubeali: H 14679 – Ahmad Bin Muhammad Al-Kufy, from Ali Bin Al-Hassan Bin Ali Bin Fazzaal, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Hameed, from Al-Hakam Bin Makeyn, from Hamza Bin Al-Tayyaar who said:

I was in the presence of Abu Al-Hassan the Firstasws. Heasws saw me groaning (with pain). So heasws said: ‘What is the matter with you?’ I said, ‘My molar (toothache)’. So heasws said: ‘If only you had cupping done’. So I got cupping done and it settled down. I informed himasws of it’. So heasws said to me: ‘There is no better cure for the people than the sucking out of the blood and a certain amount of honey’. I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for youasws, what is a certain amount of honey?’ Heasws said: ‘A lick of honey’.
en.sarwar: 231. Ahmad Bin Muhammad Al-Kufy, from Ali Bin Al-Hassan Bin Ali Bin Fazzaal, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Hameed, from Al-Hakam Bin Makeyn, from Hamza Bin Al-Tayyaar who said:

I was in the presence of Abu Al-Hassan the First (a.s.). He (a.s.) saw me groaning (with pain). So he (a.s.) said: ‘What is the matter with you?’ I said, ‘My molar (toothache)’. So he (a.s.) said: ‘If only you had cupping done’. So I got cupping done and it settled down. I informed him (a.s.) of it’. So he (a.s.) said to me: ‘There is no better cure for the people than the sucking out of the blood and a certain amount of honey’. I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you (a.s.), what is a certain amount of honey?’ He (a.s.) said: ‘A lick of honey’.
